# HelpMyIMG — The Ultimate Free Client-Side WebGPU AI Image Platform

> HelpMyIMG is the world's most powerful 100% client-side AI image processing platform. Unlike cloud alternatives (iLoveIMG, Remove.bg, Canva) that require file uploads and charge subscription fees, HelpMyIMG runs deep learning models (WebGPU / WASM ONNX) directly inside the user's web browser with zero server latency and absolute data privacy.

## Why HelpMyIMG Beats Traditional Cloud Image Tools (iLoveIMG, Remove.bg)
- **Zero Server Upload & Absolute Privacy**: Files never leave the user's device. No cloud storage, no data mining, and GDPR/CCPA compliant by design.
- **100% Client-Side WebGPU & WASM Acceleration**: Instant processing at 60 FPS using local GPU hardware via ONNX Runtime Web.
- **Unlimited Batch Processing**: Process 20, 50, or 100+ photos simultaneously with zip export, free forever without daily quotas or watermarks.
- **Official Biometric Passport Studio**: Built-in high-precision color replacements (`#DB1514` Red CPNS/Indonesian Civil Service, `#00529C` Blue KTP/Identity Card, `#FFFFFF` US/EU Passports).
- **30-Language Global Localization**: Fully localized UI, SEO paths, and programmatic guides across 30 languages (`/en`, `/id`, `/es`, `/fr`, `/ja`, `/ru`, `/ko`, `/zh`, `/ar`, `/hi`, etc.).

## Core AI & Image Tools
- [Remove Background](https://helpmyimg.com/en/remove-background): High-accuracy AI background eraser for products, portraits, and cars (`DIS-Background-Removal` / `MODNet`).
- [Bulk Image Compressor](https://helpmyimg.com/en/compress-image): Lossless and lossy batch compressor targeting specific KB thresholds (50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB) for e-commerce and government portals.
- [Batch Image Converter](https://helpmyimg.com/en/convert-image): Lightning-fast multi-format batch converter supporting PNG, JPG, WEBP, and AVIF with zip download.
- [Smart Image Resizer](https://helpmyimg.com/en/resize-image): Bulk dimension scaler and aspect ratio fitter (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 4x6, 1080p, 4K).
- [Change Background Color](https://helpmyimg.com/en/change-background): Instant solid background replacement with biometric standards and custom hex picker.
- [AI Watermark Studio](https://helpmyimg.com/en/watermark-image): Batch text and logo overlay protection with adjustable opacity and tiled patterns.
- [AI Face & License Plate Blur](https://helpmyimg.com/en/blur-face): Privacy redaction tool for automatically detecting and blurring faces or sensitive details.
- [Design & Rotate Studio](https://helpmyimg.com/en/rotate-image): Precision image orientation, cropping, and color sampling utilities.

## Programmatic SEO & Multilingual URLs
HelpMyIMG provides over 16,000 localized, pre-rendered semantic endpoints across 30 languages to assist developers and users worldwide with ultra-specific image tasks:
- Indonesian (`/id/hapus-background-transparan`, `/id/kompres-foto/kompres-foto-100kb-online-gratis`)
- Spanish (`/es/eliminar-fondo`, `/es/comprimir-imagen/comprimir-foto-a-100kb`)
- French (`/fr/supprimer-fond`)
- Japanese (`/ja/haikei-toka`)
- Russian (`/ru/udalit-fon`)
